title: 第23章 凌雪瑶认出陆成使用敛息决第24章陆成大胜被偷袭陆成斩向王飞宇
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
纵然陆成心境如水，但此刻被王飞宇这句叫嚣的话，彻底怒了！
王飞宇看到自己的话彻底激怒了陆成，微微一笑：“我要让大家好好睁大眼睛，好好看看你，你……”
王飞宇话音未落，他脸色突然一沉，因为他面前的陆成突然宛如一头猛虎朝着他冲了过来！
见到这一幕，众人皆是一愣，开场白都不要，直接开打？
陆成穿越后只经历过两次生死战斗，但这两次生死战斗，让他明白一个道理，很多时候，人都是死于话多！
这是比试，但对他而言，不亚于一场生死战斗，比试前还要叽歪两句？
抱歉，他陆成没有这个规矩！
陆成先出手，意味着他占得了先机，当他冲到王飞宇面前时，右拳紧握，势已凝聚，他直接一拳朝着王飞宇面门轰了过去！
拳风将至！
这一拳没有任何灵力的气息，只是单纯的肉身之力，但这一拳爆发速度极快，快得已打破人体界限，只留下一道残影向王飞宇面门袭去。
察觉到陆成的拳意直冲他面门而来，王飞宇的脸色微变，鼻梁骨和数颗牙齿之前被墨尘居打断，之前的痛感并未消失，若是自己让对方三招，再挨上陆成一拳，那岂不是面目全非！
王飞宇刚放出让对方三招，自己这就要被迫抵挡，他的脸色瞬间气成了猪肝色！
下意识间，王飞宇不敢再大意，右脚朝后轻轻一抵，双臂交错着朝前就是一挡！
砰！
随着一道低爆声响起，那王飞宇直接被震得朝后连连爆退！
见到这一幕，场中众人皆是愣住了。
这王飞宇第一回合竟是落了下风？
而比试圈外，王厉脸色难看至极，胡子气得发抖，看到孙子口出狂言让对方三招，紧跟着便看到直接陆成出手，他孙子更是脸上露出一丝恐慌，直接双手抵挡，气得他都要差点忍不住爆粗口了，此刻这个样子方才还装什么逼，你倒是别挡啊！！
后面那些紫袍和青袍弟子，脸色更是阴沉得可怕，这般行径差点把他们气死了！
墨尘居则是脸上露出了笑容。

凌雪瑶睁大美眸，目光在王飞宇和陆成身上来回扫视，看到陆成占上风，她美眸中露出惊讶之色！
身为比试圈内的主人公，王飞宇脸上同样露出震惊的神色，那一拳的肉身力量，竟让他吃了一个暗亏！
但也就如此了，他冷冷一笑！
陆成一击得手，并未停手，果断朝前一个跨步，借助奔跑之势，陆成再次一拳朝着王飞宇面门轰了过去！
纯粹的肉身力量！
在青玄宗，炼气一层间的决斗，很多时候打架，其实主要靠的就是肉身力量与经验，再就是灵技与灵气！
肉身经过灵气入体的淬炼，会发生翻天覆地的变化！
比试圈内，王飞宇再次双拳交错着抵挡，陆成速度极快，出手果断，招招都是直冲他的面门，直戳他弱点，气得他连连低吼，被迫抵挡。
砰！
再一次交锋后，彼此再次后退数步。
王飞宇停下来之后，他的脸色极其的难看，他并没有想到陆成的力量竟然是如此的强大，这完全超出了他的意料！见到陆成又一拳轰来，他没有选择抵挡，而是右拳紧握成拳，然后一拳对着陆成轰了过去！
这时有一位青袍弟子，气得突然开口道：“蠢货，陆成是五行灵根，身体得到五种灵气淬炼，肉身力量你怎么可能是他的对手，还不尽快用灵气！！”
王飞宇微微一愣，脸上露出原来如此的表情，紧跟着在他拳头之上，闪烁着一丝淡淡的光泽！
炼气一层，能够使用自己的灵气，来提升肉身力量！
陆成见王飞宇动用灵气，果断在拳头上覆盖了一层灵气！
content_en:
Even though Lu Cheng was in a state of mind, he was completely angered by Wang Feiyu's shouting words at this moment!
Seeing that his words had completely angered Lu Cheng, Wang Feiyu smiled slightly: "I want everyone to open their eyes and take a good look at you, you..."
Before Wang Feiyu finished speaking, his face suddenly darkened, because Lu Cheng in front of him suddenly rushed towards him like a tiger!
Seeing this scene, everyone was stunned. They didn't even need any preamble and just started fighting?
Lu Cheng only experienced two life-and-death battles after time travel, but these two life-and-death battles made him understand the truth. Many times, people die from talking too much!
This is a competition, but for him, it is no less than a life and death battle. He has to say a few words before the competition?
Sorry, he, Lu Cheng, doesn't have this rule!
Lu Cheng struck first, which meant that he had the upper hand. When he rushed in front of Wang Feiyu, his right fist was clenched and his momentum was gathered. He punched Wang Feiyu directly in the face!
The fist wind is coming!
This punch does not have any spiritual power, it is just pure physical power, but this punch explodes very fast, so fast that it breaks the boundaries of the human body, leaving only an afterimage that attacks Wang Feiyu's face.
Realizing that Lu Cheng's punch was coming straight towards his face, Wang Feiyu's expression changed slightly. The bridge of his nose and several teeth had been broken by Mo Chenju before, and the previous pain had not disappeared. If he let the opponent hit him three times and then received a punch from Lu Cheng, wouldn't it be beyond recognition?
Wang Feiyu had just released three moves for the opponent, and he was about to be forced to resist. His face instantly turned the color of pig liver with anger!
Subconsciously, Wang Feiyu didn't dare to be careless anymore. He lightly pushed his right foot back, crossed his arms and faced forward to block!
Bang!
As a low explosive sound sounded, Wang Feiyu was directly shocked and exploded backwards!
Seeing this scene, everyone in the venue was stunned.
Did Wang Feiyu lose in the first round?
Outside the competition circle, Wang Li's face was extremely ugly, and his beard was trembling with anger. He saw his grandson uttering wild words and asking the opponent to take three moves. Then he saw Lu Cheng take action. His grandson even showed a trace of panic on his face and blocked it with both hands. He was so angry that he almost couldn't help but swear. Why were you pretending to be cool at this moment? You better not block it! !
The faces of the purple-robed and green-robed disciples at the back were even more gloomy, and their behavior almost made them angry to death!
Mo Chenju had a smile on his face.
Ling Xueyao opened her beautiful eyes wide and glanced back and forth between Wang Feiyu and Lu Cheng. Seeing that Lu Cheng had the upper hand, her beautiful eyes showed surprise!
As the protagonist in the competition circle, Wang Feiyu also had a look of shock on his face. The physical power of that punch actually made him suffer a hidden loss!
But that was it, he smiled coldly!
Lu Cheng succeeded with one blow, but did not stop. He stepped forward decisively, and with the help of his running momentum, Lu Cheng punched Wang Feiyu in the face again!
Pure physical power!
In Qingxuan Sect, duels between the first level of Qi Refining, many fights, actually mainly rely on physical strength and experience, and then spiritual skills and spiritual energy!
After the physical body is tempered by the spiritual energy entering the body, it will undergo earth-shaking changes!
In the competition circle, Wang Feiyu once again interlaced his fists to resist. Lu Cheng was extremely fast and decisive. All his moves were directed at his face, poking at his weak points. He was so angry that he roared repeatedly and was forced to resist.
Bang!
After another confrontation, the two sides took a few steps back again.
After Wang Feiyu stopped, his face was extremely ugly. He did not expect that Lu Cheng's power was so powerful. This was completely beyond his expectation! Seeing another punch coming from Lu Cheng, he did not choose to resist. Instead, he clenched his right fist into a fist and punched Lu Cheng!
At this time, a disciple in green robe was so angry that he suddenly said: "Idiot, Lu Cheng has the Five Elements Spiritual Root, and his body is tempered by five kinds of spiritual energy. How can you be his opponent in terms of physical strength? Why don't you use the spiritual energy as soon as possible!!"Wang Feiyu was slightly startled, with the same expression on his face, followed by a faint luster on his fist!
At the first level of Qi refining, you can use your own spiritual energy to enhance your physical strength!
When Lu Cheng saw Wang Feiyu using spiritual energy, he decisively covered his fist with a layer of spiritual energy!
